entities.summary: Gregory Arnold Tribbett Jr. is an American musician who is the lead guitarist, backing vocalist and one of the founding members of metal band Mudvayne. He is also the former lead guitarist and backing vocalist of metal bands Audiotopsy and Hellyeah. He has been with Mudvayne since their inception in 1996 until 2010, and again from 2021 to now. He has named Randy Rhoads as the guitarist who most influenced him.
